b: 11/24/2026 – The first game of the World Championship match between defending champion Gukesh and challenger Javokhir Sindarov got off to a promising start. Sindarov opened with 1.e4, and Gukesh opted for the Berlin Defence. The variation has a reputation for being drawish, but the position soon became sharp and complicated. Gukesh came under pressure and used up a lot of time, but eventually managed to save a draw. Daniel King takes a closer look at the highlights of the game.
